visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Dequeue Returns the Newest Item
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The values 1, 2, 3 are enqueued in that order, then 4 after two removals. They should come out 1 2 3 4, but the program prints 3 2 4 1.

solution.explanation: Taking from the rear end makes the structure a stack (last in, first out). A queue must remove from the front, where the oldest item is, and then move front forward.
